mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points in the past month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in the past two months signals increased economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% over the past quarter, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points in the past month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the past month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months signals an accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity markets and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS shows a sustained decrease.
